_about: Walter Headlam (1866-1908), Fellow of King's College, Cambridge, Greek scholar and poet, raw IA OCR: Fifty Poems of Meleager with a translation (Macmillan, 1890); On Editing Aeschylus, a criticism (David Nutt, 1891); A Book of Greek Verse (Cambridge University Press, 1907); Restorations of Menander (Bowes and Bowes, 1908); Walter Headlam, his letters and poems, with a memoir by Cecil Headlam and a bibliography by L. Haward (Duckworth, 1910). His verse Agamemnon (1910), the Headlams' prose Plays of Aeschylus (1909) and his Herodas (1922) are on the aeschylus and herodas shelves. Greek-dense volumes kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dw). No uids minted.
